Remark
[Interpretation of almost ancient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0151 ↗ prop:chow-iii-almost-ancient-large-scale-collapse 1. ch20:20.5\group Almost Kappa-Solutions

For $\widetilde g_k(t)=Q_kg_k(Q_k^{-1}t)$, the hypotheses say that the backward time intervals tend to $(-\infty ,0]$ and that $R\le 2$ on balls whose radii tend to infinity. Thus the sequence becomes ancient and globally bounded in the pointed limit.
